keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Académico de Viseu 0, Rio Ave 1. Miguel Patrício (Rio Ave) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by João Tomé with a cross.
First Half ends, Académico de Viseu 0, Rio Ave 1.
Second Half begins Académico de Viseu 0, Rio Ave 1.
Jalen Blesa (Rio Ave) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Soufiane Messeguem (Académico de Viseu) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Miguel Patrício (Rio Ave).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Alejandro Mestanza replaces Cihan Kahraman.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Hugo Gambor replaces Anthony Correia.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Lorougnon Gohi replaces João Guilherme.
Goal! Académico de Viseu 1, Rio Ave 1. Soufiane Messeguem (Académico de Viseu) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by André Clóvis.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Malik Sellouki replaces Miguel Patrício.
Georgios Liavas (Rio Ave) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Académico de Viseu 2, Rio Ave 1. André Clóvis (Académico de Viseu) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alejandro Mestanza with a through ball.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Zé Carlos replaces João Tomé.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Tamble Monteiro replaces Sebastian Clemmensen.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Valery Fernández replaces Nils Mortimer.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Ryan Guilherme replaces Georgios Liavas.
Substitution, Académico de Viseu. Mohamed Bouldini replaces André Clóvis.
Andreas Ntoi (Rio Ave) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Second Half ends, Académico de Viseu 2, Rio Ave 1.
